prompt: Expression sheet of the exact same young dragon from the reference images. Keep the identical character design, art style, colours, shading and proportions: a lean adolescent dragon with a small head on a long neck, a real snout with a gentle jaw, smaller almond-shaped dark plum eyes with white highlights, light rosy cheeks, lavender body, pale mint belly with soft horizontal lines, mint wings with lavender edges, exactly two long swept-back warm gold horns plus one small gold nub on top of the head, gold spikes down the back of the neck. Every expression is gentle and positive, never sad or angry. Soft flat 2D illustration with gentle cel shading, no outlines, no text, no labels. Plain flat solid pale background, no shadows, no scenery.
